title: Equal algebraic rank does not determine an observation lattice or norm spectrum
problem: Transfer the octagonal arithmetic spectrum method to a regular dodecagonal walk.
failure: Copying the octagon's parity lattice, unit period, or prime factors to the dodecagon would give incorrect spectra. Equal algebraic rank does not imply equal observation models.
correction: Derive the step difference lattice, field embeddings and unit subgroup anew. Apply classical prime splitting and class number one, then compare with completeness-bounded direct enumeration including zero classes.
transfer: When generalizing a structural theorem to a new geometry, preserve the method but rederive lattice support, covariance, symmetry group and algebraic field. Test both positive and zero coefficients.
limits: R16 compares two specified unit polygon walks; exact norm comparisons through 2000 and 2401 unit checks. Bessel and phase values numerical proxies, no certified quadrature/tail or finite-time simulation, inverse uniqueness, independent review, physical or novelty claim.
author: TOTO
